capaData.remarks: Rectified, adjusted  based on required jamb alignment
capaData.nonConformance: Not aligned Door jamb
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and re‑install misaligned jamb to achieve proper alignment based on the adjacent door jamb and wall alignment.
capaData.preventiveAction: Establish reference layout and ensure uniform fastening sequence to prevent shifting. Maintain strict supervision/monitoring and inspection during and after  installation.
capaData.rootCause:
Improper positioning or established reference layout/line was not verified/double check during installation. 
Insufficient temporary bracing or fixing, allowing the jamb to shift before final securing.

capaData.nonConformance: Not aligned Ceiling manhole frame corners and on ceiling board
capaData.correctiveAction:
1.Remove and re‑install misaligned frame to achieve flush with ceiling board and square alignment of frame corner.
2.Replace defective frame if alignment cannot be corrected.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1.Assign qualified/experienced personnel in installing manhole ceiling frames. 
2.Maintain strict supervision and inspection during and after completion of activity.
capaData.rootCause: Careless/uneven fixing of frame without checking frame corner alignment and the frame alignment/flushness on ceiling board.

capaData.nonConformance: Misaligned installed Wall tiles at Lower Ground CR
capaData.correctiveAction: Carefully remove affected tiles and reinstall tiles to achieve proper alignment, levelness, plumbness, and uniform joint spacing.
capaData.preventiveAction: 1. Implement a pre-installation inspection specially layout verification, and reference lines. 2. Ensure installation uses appropriate tile spacers, leveling systems where applicable.
capaData.rootCause: 1. Failure to continuously check tile alignment, level, plumbness, and joint consistency during installation. 2.Insufficient supervision during tile laying.

capaData.nonConformance: Chipped-Off Corners of Corner cut Tiles
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and replace affected tiles with new defect-free tiles. Ensure corner cuts are performed using appropriate tile-cutting tools and techniques.
capaData.preventiveAction: Use quality and sharp diamond blades suitable for tile cutting. The installer shall present a sample of an installed corner cut tile for approval as a reference prior to proceeding with the remaining corner areas.
capaData.rootCause: Improper cutting technique or use of a worn-out cutting blades. Failure to inspect cut tiles prior to installation.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven painted ceiling joint Surface (2 Flr.- B.Rm. 3)
capaData.correctiveAction: Sand, grind, or re-level uneven joints before repainting. Reapply primer/top coat after correcting joint defects.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure thorough surface preparation: joints must be leveled, filled, and dried before painting.
2. Enforce use of adequate temporary lighting (side lighting) to reveal surface imperfections.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Applied jointing compound not leveled, also Inadequate sanding of surface.
2. Insufficient lighting during paint application resulted in defects being overlooked.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Area not rendered or finished to match adjacent textured surface around pipe penetration (Roofdeck)
capaData.correctiveAction: Apply rendering or skim-coat to achieve uniform surface level and apply textured finish to match adjacent surfaces.
capaData.preventiveAction: Implement mandatory pre-work inspection for all penetrations and substrate repairs.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Lack of proper rendering or skim coat at pipe penetration area and textured finish application.
2. Insufficient supervision and inspection before finishing works.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Uneven wall surface and Surface Textured Design Finish at Exterior (2nd flr- Right Airwell)
capaData.correctiveAction: Perform grinding, followed by application of skim coat/ rendering on uneven wall surface then reapply textured finish, ensure a consistent appearance matched with adjacent finished area.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. The supervisor-in-charge shall require pre-work inspection and approval of substrate conditions prior to commencing wall finishing activities.
2. Use consistent batch mixing for texture application.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Inadequate substrate preparation observed; plastering joints were not rendered or skim-coated prior to textured finish application.
2. Inadequate mixing ratio & Inconsistent application technique.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven Surface Finish of exterior wall (3rd Floor Balcony- Rear)
capaData.correctiveAction: Perform grinding, followed by application of skim coat/ rendering on uneven wall surface then reapply textured finish, ensure a consistent appearance matched with adjacent finished area.
capaData.preventiveAction: The supervisor-in-charge shall require pre-work inspection and approval of substrate conditions prior to commencing wall finishing activities.
capaData.rootCause: Inadequate substrate preparation observed; plastering joints were not rendered or skim-coated prior to textured finish application.

capaData.nonConformance: Unfinished/ untextured finish at the base of a wall (2nd Flr- BedRm. 2 Balcony)
capaData.correctiveAction: 1. Prepare the substrate in accordance with project specifications and apply the specified textured finish at the wall base and ensure full coverage down to the flooring line.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Conduct pre-final inspection of wall finishes before area turnover.
2. Supervisor to monitor finishing works closely, especially at wall bases and junctions.
capaData.rootCause: Incomplete application of textured finish on wall during execution and Inadequate supervision or inspection during final finishing stage.

capaData.nonConformance: Gap difference between floor tiles  & zocalo (2nd Flr- Bedroom 2 Balcony)
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and replace improperly cut or installed perimeter (seruho) tiles to achieve a consistent and acceptable gap, also the correct alignment of tile termination.
capaData.preventiveAction: Supervisor encharge to monitor and verify perimeter cuts and alignment, also orient and remind concerned workers to ensure that the perimeter tiles (seruho) are cut precisely to fit wall junctions.
capaData.rootCause: Inaccurate tile cutting and insufficient dimensional checks during floor tile installation resulting in inconsistent perimeter gaps.

capaData.nonConformance: Misalignment of underside of Beam (2nd Flr- Masters Bed Rm.)
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. If the misalignment is minor, apply grinding, plastering, or leveling compound to achieve uniform underside, or
2. If the misalignment is major Install corrective cladding to conceal the defect.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure accurate setting out and leveling of formwork, adequate bracing and support of formwork to prevent movement during concreting operations. 
2. Jacking operations must be synchronized to ensure even and uniform lifting, and visual checks must be conducted to ensure that the supports/anchorage for the formwork is fully engaged
capaData.rootCause:
1. Improper leveling or alignment of shuttering during beam casting,
2. Movement or displacement of beam supports during concrete placement.

capaData.nonConformance: Misalignment of underside of Beam (2nd Flr-Bed Rm. 1)
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. If the misalignment is minor, apply grinding, plastering, or leveling compound to achieve uniform underside, or
2. If the misalignment is major Install corrective cladding to conceal the defect.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure accurate setting out and leveling of formwork, adequate bracing and support of formwork to prevent movement during concreting operations. 
2. Jacking operations must be synchronized to ensure even and uniform lifting, and visual checks must be conducted to ensure that the supports/anchorage for the formwork is fully engaged
capaData.rootCause:
1. Improper leveling or alignment of shuttering during beam casting,
2. Movement or displacement of beam supports during concrete placement.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven perimeter/seruho Ceiling panel (3rd Flr)
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and reinstall panels ensuring proper alignment with the existing adjacent ceiling panels.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Remind installers emphasizing alignment tolerances and installation requirements.
2. Supervisor-in-charge to monitor activities and enforce compliance during implementation.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Insufficient checking of straightness or panel alignment during installation. 
2. Improper Fixing or Fastening of installed ceiling panel.

capaData.remarks: The identified area was rectified in accordance with the approved procedure.
capaData.nonConformance: Ponding of Water in Tiled Floor at 3rd Floor
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. Remove affected tiles in areas where slope does not meet requirements. 
2. Reinstall tiles ensuring proper alignment, elevation, and slope requirement.
capaData.preventiveAction: Check the grade using a laser level or water level and set/ install a reference string to maintain the correct slope during the tile installation.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Insufficient floor slope toward the installed floor drain.
2. Inadequate leveling and alignment control during tile laying.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven installed PVC Panel Cladding at 3rd Flr Balcony
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and verify substrate/frame alignment, and levelness before reinstallation.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Verify squareness of framing/substructure prior to cladding board installation.
2. Verify/check squareness of cladding during and after installation.
capaData.rootCause: Inadequate alignment and level control during installation.

capaData.nonConformance: Gap between the installed PVC Cladding and Flr Tile (Due to early installation of floor tiles)
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove affected tiles/seruho and reinstall with correct sizing and alignment to fit-up with the PVC cladding.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Supervisor encharge to verify and monitor installation sequence and alignment of tiles being installed.
2. In accordance with the work sequence done, cut and install the perimeter floor tiles (seruho) up to the edge of the cladding frames to ensure that the PVC panels rest directly on the tiled surface.”
capaData.rootCause:
1. Insufficient coordination between floor tile installer and supervisor encharge.
2. The floor tiles were installed prior to the PVC cladding works, resulting in fit-up and interface alignment issues between the two finishes.

capaData.nonConformance: Gap difference between the floor tile and wall (G.Floor- Kitchen)
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and replace improperly cut or installed perimeter (seruho) tiles to achieve a consistent and acceptable gap
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure perimeter tiles (seruho) are cut precisely to fit wall junctions. 
2. Supervisor encharge to monitor and verify perimeter cuts and alignment.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Inaccurate tile cutting, or setting-out resulting in inconsistent perimeter gaps.
2. Insufficient dimensional checks during floor tile installation.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven Floor Tile (G. Flr- Dining Area)
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and reinstall affected tiles requiring proper leveling.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Require mandatory use of tile leveling clips/spacers for all floor tiling works.
2. Increase supervisor inspection frequency during tile installation.
capaData.rootCause: Absence or improper use of tile leveling system/spacers and lack of continuous level checking during installation.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Cement Stains or Residue on Installed Floor tiles at Roof Deck (Due to Consistent washing of tools/materials during floor tile Installation)
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. Perform comprehensive cleaning of all affected roof deck tiles.
2. Replace tiles that remain stained, etched, discolored, or damaged after cleaning.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Designate a dedicated wash area away from the completed and finished floor tiles.
2. Strict supervision, Supervisor encharge to monitor worker practices and enforce discipline.
capaData.rootCause: Final cleaning was delayed, allowing cement residue to harden on the tile surface.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Rust Stains in Floor tiles (Due to fabrication works of Airwell Gratings)
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. Clean affected floor tile and replace tiles that cannot be restored.
2. Remove metal filings, debris, and rust contaminants from the area immediately. Install temporary protective coverings over floor tiles prior to resuming fabrication works.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Require mandatory installation of protective coverings and spark barriers before any metal cutting, grinding, or welding activity.
2. Require complete cleaning after fabrication activity.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Metal fabrication activities (cutting, grinding, welding) were performed in the area and steel dust were allowed to accumulate on tile surfaces and subsequently oxidized, causing rust stains.
2. Lack of adequate protection covering on installed floor tiles during fabrication works.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Visible fiber mesh in beam-wall corners (Airwell- Left side)
capaData.correctiveAction: Grind identified areas, clean and prepare the surface per approved methods, then reapply the specified waterproofing membrane with textured finish and final paint finish.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure sufficient lightings are provided in all enclosed areas during implementation of painting works to identify inconsistencies quickly.
2.	Supervisor encharge to check corners and pay special attention to beam-wall junctions, where mesh exposure is more likely. Ensure fiber mesh is fully covered with adequate thickness of waterproofing material
capaData.rootCause:
1. Waterproofing material applied at inadequate thickness over corner reinforcement areas.
2. Insufficient lighting during implementation prevented the immediate/ quick identification of inconsistencies.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Paint sticks to vent caps (Installed on Exterior walls)
capaData.correctiveAction: Carefully remove paint from vent caps using an approved cleaning method that will not damage the finish.
capaData.preventiveAction: Use temporary covers, masking tape, or protective wraps for all exposed vent caps during painting works.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Vent caps were not adequately protected or masked prior to painting activities.
2. Insufficient supervision or inspection during painting works.

capaData.remarks: The concerned workers were immediately instructed to stop mixing concrete/adhesive on the completed waterproofed area and to use suitable available materials as a mixing board. Supervisor encharged was informed and advised to monitor the ongoing activity.
capaData.nonConformance: Mixing of Concrete Topping/ Adhessive on Water proofed CR Floor (LG CR), which may damage the applied waterproofing
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. Stop all mixing activities on the waterproofed floor immediately. 
2. For any possible damaged area, remove and repair sections of the damaged waterproofing membrane.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Install mandatory protective coverings before allowing subsequent trades to work above completed waterproofing. 
2. Supervisor-in-charge to monitor activities and enforce compliance during implementation.
capaData.rootCause: 1. Insufficient awareness by workers and supervisors regarding protection requirements for completed waterproofing works.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven surface of installed Floor Tiles
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and reinstall affected tiles requiring proper leveling and spacers/ levelers.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Require mandatory use of tile leveling clips/spacers for all floor tiling works.
2. Increase supervisor inspection frequency during tile installation.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Absence or improper use of tile leveling system/spacers and lack of continuous level checking during installation. 
2. Lack of supervision: No inspection during critical stages of tile laying.

capaData.remarks: The noted issue was repaired following the approved corrective process.
capaData.nonConformance: Uneven painted ceiling joint Surface (2 Flr.- B.Rm. 3)
capaData.correctiveAction: Sand, grind, or re-level uneven joints before repainting. Reapply primer/top coat after correcting joint defects.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure thorough surface preparation: joints must be leveled, filled, and dried before painting.
2. Enforce use of adequate temporary lighting (side lighting) to reveal surface imperfections.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Applied jointing compound not leveled, also Inadequate sanding of surface.
2. Insufficient lighting during paint application resulted in defects being overlooked.

capaData.remarks: The noted issue was repaired following the approved corrective process.
capaData.nonConformance: Visible fiber mesh on painted ceiling (2 Flr.- B.Rm. 3)
capaData.correctiveAction:
1. Re-skim coat affected areas with proper thickness to fully cover mesh.
2. Apply primer to seal repaired surfaces, then repaint with uniform technique.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Ensure fiber mesh is fully embedded in skim coat with adequate coverage.
2. All surfaces shall be inspected prior to primer and topcoat paint application to ensure early detection of defects.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Improper sanding and surface preparation prior to painting.
2. Insufficient skim coat thickness, Fiber mesh not fully embedded leaving texture visible after painting.

capaData.remarks: The noted issue was repaired following the approved corrective process.
capaData.nonConformance: Uneven Surface Textured Design Finish at Exterior
capaData.correctiveAction: Perform grinding, followed by reapplication of textured finish ensuring a consistent appearance matched with approved sample or adjacent finished area.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Monitor environmental conditions; avoid application during extreme heat or strong winds.
2. Use consistent batch mixing.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Inadequate mixing ratio & Inconsistent application technique (uneven trowel/roller/spray pressure and motion). 
2. Lack of control on material thickness and coverage rate.
3. Environmental factors (rapid drying due to sun/wind) affecting uniformity.

capaData.nonConformance: Uneven Installed Floor Tile at 3rd Flr Balcony
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and reinstall affected tiles requiring proper leveling and spacers/ levelers.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Require mandatory use of tile leveling clips/spacers for all floor tiling works.
2. Increase supervisor inspection frequency during tile installation.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Absence or improper use of tile leveling system/spacers and lack of continuous level checking during installation. 
2. Insufficient supervision and monitoring during tile installation.

capaData.nonConformance: Alignment of Ceiling Corner edge (2 Flr.- B.Rm. 3)
capaData.correctiveAction: Realign the ceiling corner/termination by Re-cutting the existing ceiling edge and repaint corrected areas
capaData.preventiveAction: Establish clear reference lines and measurements before ceiling board installation.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Lack of reference control lines (not properly established or followed)
2. Lack of supervision, No inspection after ceiling board installation

capaData.nonConformance: Unsquared installed Exterior Cladding (G.Flr Near Entrance Stairs)
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove cladding, rectify and align the frame to square if necessary prior to cladding reinstallation.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Verify squareness of framing/substructure prior to cladding board installation.
2. Verify/check squareness of cladding during and after installation.
capaData.rootCause:
1. No inspection/ verification of frame squareness/ alignment before cladding board installation.
2. Frame misalignment was not corrected before cladding installation.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Visible different color of stripe line on ceiling corner (Roof deck main Stair)
capaData.correctiveAction: Re-prepare surface (light sanding, re-priming if required) and apply final coating to the whole ceiling area.
capaData.preventiveAction: Adequate lighting shall be provided during painting activities to enable early detection of inconsistencies.
capaData.rootCause: Uneven application thickness or number of coats.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Alignment of corner floor tile at roof deck
capaData.correctiveAction: Remove and reinstall misaligned tiles ensuring proper alignment with the existing floor tiles.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Establish clear reference lines (chalk line or laser) before starting tile installation.
2. Provide adequate supervision and regular checks during tile installation to confirm alignment.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Inconsistent spacing or installed joint spacer size. 
2. Insufficient supervision during tile installation, failed to monitor tile placement and alignment checks.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Tile grout stain on parapet wall paint (Roof Deck)
capaData.correctiveAction: Repaint stained areas if cleaning does not restore original finish.
capaData.preventiveAction:
1. Implement mandatory protection protocol (masking, covering)
2. Supervisor encharge must verify that adjacent finishes are properly protected before grouting begins, and ensure proper cleanup is executed after application.
capaData.rootCause:
1. Inadequate protection of painted parapet wall during tile grouting works.
2. Supervisor failed to enforce protective measures or immediate cleanup protocols.

capaData.projectLocation: Adarna St., Dizon Subd., Baguio City
capaData.nonConformance: Providing of drip mold under the beam surface (1B Rear Side)
capaData.correctiveAction: Install drip mold on affected beam surfaces using approved method (cut groove or attach molding strip).
capaData.preventiveAction: Supervisor to monitor and inspect beam formworks installation and ensure drip mold is provided in required areas.
capaData.rootCause: Inadequate supervision during beam formwork installation.
